assessments.name: Group pitch Presentation
assessments.description: Students in assigned groups will present their views on an assigned topic.

assessments.name: In-semester Test
assessments.description: In class BYOD locked down browser in Canvas and Respondus

assessments.name: Group pitch Q&A session
assessments.description: Students in assigned groups will respond to queries by a panel on their pitch performance.
assessments.type: Q&A following presentation, submission or placement

assessments.name: Opinion Piece
assessments.description: Students will be required to critically analyse how their own organization can leverage Indigenous knowledge. On these bases, they will develop a thought leadership piece suitable for publication as an opinion piece. (hurdle task set at 50%)

assessments.name: Group peer assessment - feedback fruit
assessments.description: Students will be required to assess individual contributions to the group assignment via the ‘Feedback Fruit’ platform integrated in Canvas.
